from_end: Filter-regulator under the car (58 psi, returnless; the fuel plan)
to_end: Fuel rail inlet, driver side rear
route: Along the inside of the driver frame rail and up behind the driver head, under the intake's rear lip - nothing on top of the engine
material: PTFE-lined braided hose, black jacket, or 3/8 in hard line
ends: -6 AN to the regulator; the rail's 3/8 in quick-connect through an adapter
note: The LM4's returnless rail (SP spec) means one line into the bay; the return stays under the car

route: Under the car beside LL01 - never in the bay

to_end: Purge solenoid (LD20), then the throttle body's purge port
route: Canister and solenoid hidden low behind the passenger head or under the cowl; one short hose to the port
note: Kept so the car passes as its engine's year (D-622); the solenoid moved out of sight, not deleted

route: Behind the intake, down the firewall to the booster - short and hidden
note: The FB booster's port size confirm at M01

from_end: Valve cover or valley PCV port
route: Under the intake's front edge - hidden
material: Factory PCV hose, or a hidden catch can inline
note: DR01 decides the factory route or a valley-cover PCV with a hidden catch can

route: Tucked along the valve cover edge into the intake tube

to_end: Radiator top or the expansion tank (DS04)
route: A crossover tube across the front of the heads, behind the drive's belt plane, then one line to the radiator high point
ends: -4 AN at each port, a tee at the crossover
finish: Painted to match the engine or brushed
note: Must reach the highest point of the system or the heads steam-pocket

from_end: Water pump outlet (the pump the drive in DS01 takes)
route: Shortest straight run across the front of the engine
material: Mandrel-bent aluminum tube with short silicone couplers, or one moulded hose
ends: Hidden constant-tension clamps, clocked out of sight
finish: Tube polished, painted or black; couplers one colour
note: Pump outlet side follows the pump chosen at DS01

to_end: Thermostat housing on the water pump inlet
note: The LS thermostat sits on the inlet (lower) side

from_end: The engine's heater outlet (pump or block, per the pump chosen)
to_end: FB heater core inlet at the firewall
route: Along the back of a head, low, to the firewall pass-through
material: Hard line with a short hose at each end
note: The FB core's pipe sizes and positions confirm at M01

route: Tank mounted out of sight in a front corner
At the filter, under the engine

route: Low along the frame rail to the condenser
material: Barrier hose and aluminum tube, custom crimped
note: Line routes follow the drive's compressor position

route: Along the firewall and frame rail, out of sight
material: Barrier hose and aluminum tube, custom crimped

from_end: Air filter in a sealed box in a front corner, fed by a duct from the grille or headlamp opening
route: The shortest smooth run along the frame rail to the throttle body
material: Mandrel-bent aluminum or a moulded tube, silicone couplers
ends: IAT boss (LD06); the PCV fresh-air port (LL06)
note: DR04 designs it; speed-density on MAP leaves the MAF (LD07) out unless the tune wants it

route: Down the firewall and along the tunnel, clipped every 300 mm
material: Braided hose or steel hard line

route: Under the car; designed at DR05
finish: Headers ceramic-coated; the rest per DR07

line: Truck fuel and EVAP lines on the engine

line: Throttle body coolant lines, if this LM4's throttle body has them
